visual.general_description: Screenshot of a remote cardiac telemetry software window showing a 12-lead ECG with a lead I rhythm strip and an auto-interpretation text panel.
visual.detailed_description: A software screen on a light grey background. The main area is a pink ECG grid with a three-row by four-column arrangement of leads labelled I, aVR, V1, V4 (top row), II, aVL, V2, V5 (middle row) and III, aVF, V3, V6 (bottom row), with the label 20 mm/mV at the top right, and a separate long lead I rhythm strip along the bottom. Complexes are narrow and irregularly spaced across leads. Along the top are buttons labelled Edit Patient, Acknowledge (greyed out) and End Prescription; red header text across the top centre is partly cut off at the image edge and its reading is uncertain. A black rectangle covers the top-left corner. The right-hand panel is titled ECG Auto Interpretation, with a field reading Abnormal and a text box reading Glasgow HR: 84, ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, NO OTHER FINDING, a divider line, PBI HR: 79, then Abnormal ECG., Sinus arrhythmia., Atrial premature complex., Low voltage in extremity leads (QRS < 0.5 mV)., Low voltage in precordial leads (QRS < 1.0 mV). and Right ventricular hypertrophy. No patient name, date or time is legible.

pixel_observations: Twelve-lead ECG layout with lead labels I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF and V1 to V6 and a bottom lead I rhythm strip; scale label 20 mm/mV.
Narrow complexes with irregular spacing between them; no printed rate on the tracing itself.
Buttons Edit Patient, Acknowledge (greyed) and End Prescription; partly cut-off red header text at the top whose reading is uncertain.
Black rectangle over the top-left corner obscuring text.

Auto-interpretation panel prints Abnormal, Glasgow HR: 84, ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, NO OTHER FINDING, PBI HR: 79 and the lines Abnormal ECG., Sinus arrhythmia., Atrial premature complex., Low voltage in extremity leads (QRS < 0.5 mV)., Low voltage in precordial leads (QRS < 1.0 mV)., Right ventricular hypertrophy.

caption_claims.value: Caption states telemetry monitoring with a CardiacLinx platform exhibiting AF with RVR at 135 beats per minute

evidence.quote: Telemetry monitoring with CardiacLinx platform exhibiting atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response at 135 beats per minute.

clinical_significance.statement: The text presents the image as real-time remote monitoring and interpretation of one home episode of AF with RVR managed by the cardiologist.

evidence.quote: The image shows real-time monitoring and interpretation of one episode of home AF with RVR managed remotely by the cardiologist.

limitations: The caption rate of 135 beats per minute is not printed in the image; the auto-interpretation panel prints different rates (84 and 79), so the caption rate cannot be confirmed from pixels and no rate is read from the tracing.
No date, time or episode identifier is legible, so the strip is not tied to a specific episode beyond the text statement.
Red header text at the top is cut off and its reading is uncertain.
